beats.beat: The CHILD is playing happily in the garden when a tiny, soft meow sounds from behind the flowerpots.
The CHILD peeks behind the big green leaves and discovers a fluffy little kitten with curious eyes.
The kitten takes two cautious steps forward, gently sniffing the CHILD's shoe with a twitching pink nose.
The CHILD speaks in a very quiet, gentle voice and slowly extends a welcoming hand.
The kitten nuzzles the CHILD's palm and begins to purr softly like a tiny motor.
The CHILD notices the kitten's little tummy rumbling softly from hunger.
The CHILD brings out a shallow dish of fresh water and a small bowl of tasty treats.
The kitten laps up the water eagerly and playfully chases a fluttering butterfly across the grass.
The CHILD and the family look around the friendly neighborhood street to see where the kitten belongs.
A smiling neighbor with a warm smile calls out, delighted to spot her adventurous little pet.
The neighbor hugs the kitten and warmly thanks the CHILD for being such a kind and caring friend.
The neighbor says the CHILD is always welcome to visit and play with the kitten whenever they want.
The kitten gives one last happy purr and rubs affectionately against the CHILD's leg before heading inside.
As evening arrives, the CHILD tells their family all about the special four-legged friend they helped today.
The CHILD falls asleep with a warm heart and a big smile, dreaming of playful garden adventures.
